description: Universal Codebase Intelligence & Cosmic Web Dependency Visualizer

scripts.site: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); http.createServer((q,s)=>{let p=path.join('docs', q.url==='/'?'index.html':q.url); fs.readFile(p,(e,c)=>{const ext=path.extname(p); const ct=ext==='.css'?'text/css':ext==='.js'?'application/javascript':'text/html'; s.writeHead(e?404:200,{'Content-Type':ct}); s.end(e?'404':c)})}).listen(5000,()=>console.log('🚀 Website running at http://localhost:5000'))"
